decision: The context-rebuild class is decomposed end-to-end. ANSWER: the cost is NOT the semantic core at these fixture sizes — with the offline mock the compact command is 135.1ms p50 and refine 107.6ms p50 of AROUND-WORK: compact = 49.6ms pre-LLM assembly (digest 11.9 + cut 17.4 + tokens 6.0 + details/aux 14.3) + 36.5ms regime-bound durable commit + 13.4ms materialization + 8.0ms kernel handoff + 10.6ms request-build; refine = 31.3ms pre-LLM assembly + ~40ms materialization + ~4ms durable writes. The size-scaling (256KiB controls) shows the file-size-scaled classes: compact assembly 49.6->2.7ms, refine assembly 31.3->2.3ms, refine materialization ~40->1.65ms. Plus a client-visible event-visibility finding: the compaction_start frame is delayed +46ms behind non-yielding pre-summarizer CPU work (flush starvation until the first await). Six around-work candidates reported for the queue (materialization, visibility, assembly, digest capture placement, empty-plan save, kernel sync); the semantic core excluded by design.
